Package com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy

Class ProxyPingEvent

java.lang.Object
com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy.ProxyPingEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResultedEvent<ResultedEvent.GenericResult>
@AwaitingEvent public final class ProxyPingEvent extends Object implements ResultedEvent<ResultedEvent.GenericResult>
This event is fired when a request for server information is sent by a remote client, or when the server sends the MOTD and favicon to the client after a successful login. Velocity will wait on this event to finish firing before delivering the results to the remote client. However, you are urged to handle this event as quickly as possible when handling this event due to the number of ping packets a client can send.
